text: Thai Beverage's FY2025 annual report ('Statistics of Shareholders', as at 11 December 2025) shows Siriwana Co., Ltd. with a 45.24% direct holding plus a deemed 20.60% through wholly-owned Siriwanan Co., Ltd.; Siriwana is owned by Sirivadhanabhakdi family companies and their discretionary trust.

source.name: Thai Beverage PCL: Annual Report 2025 (SGX filing 871645), 'Statistics of Shareholders'
source.note: Direct interest shown for Siriwana (45.24%) and Siriwanan (20.60%); the same table shows members of the Sirivadhanabhakdi family deemed interested in 65.84%.
